name: dart-rating
title: Dart Rating
description: Rate something from 1 to 10 by throwing a dart. Press and hold on the board to aim: the reticle wobbles more the longer you hold while a power meter fills, and letting go throws. The ring the dart lands in is the rating, a score and a word appear under the board, and throwing again pulls the old dart out. Number and arrow keys throw a perfect dart straight to that ring, and the board is a real slider for screen readers.
